description: Rank the venues in one or more curated FairWhere Placelists by FairWhere Score for this group. Free estimate-only path: no Google calls, no credits. Returns top venues with banded scores, per-person journey burden, score-factor breakdown, citations, and a continue_on_fairwhere link. Provide placelistIds and/or placelistSlugs (from list_placelists).

activity.description: What the group is meeting for.

mode.description: How the group is expected to travel.

participants.description: Group members with home / origin addresses (and optional return destinations).

placelistIds.description: One or more curated Placelist (business_list) UUIDs to rank WITHIN. Prefer discovering these via list_placelists.

placelistSlugs.description: Alternative to placelistIds: public Placelist slugs from list_placelists (e.g. london-parks).

name: fair_shortlist
title: Fair shortlist (FairWhere Score)
